description:
Create a new clinical form definition in the OpenMRS administration interface.

1. Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration page (https://localhost/openmrs/admin).
   - Username: superman
   - Password: Admin123

2. Create a new form with the following EXACT details:
   - Name: COVID-19 Screening Form
   - Version: 1.0
   - Description: Screening form for COVID-19 symptoms and exposure history
   - Published: Yes (Checked)

3. Save the form so it appears in the Manage Forms list.
